Jin are with the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, Ningbo University, Ningbo 315211, China (e-mail: {yaojunteng, jinming}@nbu.edu.cn). Thanks:
arxiv-2310-07550.creator: Junteng Yao, Tuo Wu, Xiazhi Lai, Ming Jin, Member, IEEE, Cunhua Pan, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2310-07550.description: Abstract This paper investigates the efficacy of utilizing fluid antenna system (FAS) at a legitimate monitor to oversee suspicious communication. The monitor switches the antenna position to minimize its outage probability for enhancing the monitoring performance. Our objective is to maximize the average monitoring rate, whose expression involves the integral of the first-order Marcum Q Q function.

arxiv-2411-15032.title: Threetangle in the XY-model class with a non-integrable field background
arxiv-2411-15032.creator: Jörg Neveling, Andreas Osterloh
arxiv-2411-15032.description: Abstract The square root of the threetangle is calculated for the transverse XY-model with an integrability-breaking in-plane field component. To be in a regime of quasi-solvability of the convex roof, we concentrate on a 4-site model Hamiltonian. In general, the field and hence a mixing of the odd/even sectors, has a detrimental effect on the threetangle, as expected.

arxiv-2506-03232.title: Pivoting the Paradigm: The Role of Spreadsheets in K–12 Data Science nhorton@amherst.edu
arxiv-2506-03232.creator: Oren Tirschwell
arxiv-2506-03232.description: Abstract Spreadsheet tools are widely accessible to and commonly used by K–12 students and teachers. They have an important role in data collection and organization. Beyond data organization, spreadsheets also make data visible and easy to interact with, facilitating student engagement in data exploration and analysis.

arxiv-2507-07332.title: Manifestation Of Quantum Forces In Spacetime: Towards A General Theory Of Quantum Forces
arxiv-2507-07332.creator: Raheem Adom
arxiv-2507-07332.description: Abstract This study introduces the quantum force wave equation (QFWE) as a general theory of quantum forces, a novel framework that redefines quantum forces as emergent phenomena arising from the interaction between quantum particles and curved spacetime. By coupling wavefunctions to spacetime curvature and gauge fields, the theory establishes a dynamic, bidirectional relationship between quantum states and spacetime geometry.

arxiv-2509-19229.title: Analytical results for large- N c N_{c} scalar QCD 2 \text{QCD}_{2}
arxiv-2509-19229.creator: Pavel Meshcheriakov
arxiv-2509-19229.description: Abstract We study large- N c N_{c} scalar QCD 2 , a 1 + 1 1+1 -dimensional confining gauge theory with fundamental scalar quarks, whose meson spectrum is governed by a Bethe-Salpeter equation structurally parallel to the ’t Hooft equation.

arxiv-2512-03389.title: Continuous Prompts: LLM-Augmented Pipeline Processing over Unstructured Streams
arxiv-2512-03389.creator: Shu Chen, Deepti Raghavan, Uğur Çetintemel
arxiv-2512-03389.description: Abstract . Monitoring unstructured streams increasingly requires persistent, semantics-aware computation, yet today’s LLM frameworks remain stateless and one-shot, limiting their usefulness for long-running analytics. We introduce Continuous Prompts (CPs), the first framework that brings LLM reasoning into continuous stream processing.

arxiv-2602-09545.title: Interaction-driven spin polaron in itinerant flat-band ferromagnetism
arxiv-2602-09545.creator: Wei-Tao Zhou, Zhao-Yang Dong, Jian-Xin Li
arxiv-2602-09545.description: Abstract Interaction effects are dramatically enhanced in flat-band systems due to quenched kinetics, facilitating the binding of single excitations into composite quasiparticles. In this work, we present a comprehensive study of spin polarons over the entire momentum and energy space within the Mielke-Tasaki model using projected exact diagonalization.

pmc-10708565.title: Rapid Detection of Total Viable Count in Intact Beef Dishes Based on NIR Hyperspectral Hybrid Model
pmc-10708565.creator: Wensong Wei, Fengjuan Zhang, Fangting Fu, Shuo Sang, Zhen Qiao
pmc-10708565.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The total viable count (TVC) of bacteria is an important index to evaluate the freshness and safety of dishes. To improve the accuracy and robustness of spectroscopic detection of total viable bacteria count in a complex system, a new method based on a near-infrared (NIR) hyperspectral hybrid model and Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithms was developed to directly determine the total viable count in intact beef dish samples in this study.

pmc-11457778.title: Single-Cell Sequencing Combined with Transcriptome Sequencing to Explore the Molecular Mechanisms Related to Psoriasis
pmc-11457778.creator: Cailing E, Rongying Wang, Zudong Meng, Yulin Zou
pmc-11457778.description: BackgroundPsoriasis, a chronic and recurrent inflammatory skin disease, current treatments can only alleviate its symptoms. There is still no complete cure. Although increasing research supports the therapeutics to be better, the common mechanism of its occurrence is still not fully elucidated. Our study is about further explore the molecular mechanism of the occurrence of this disease.

pmc-12990133.title: Immune checkpoint imbalance in ANCA-associated vasculitis: insights into disease activity and precision immunotherapy
pmc-12990133.creator: Lydia García-Serrano, Laura Martinez-Valenzuela, Juliana Draibe
pmc-12990133.description: Anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibody (ANCA)–associated vasculitis (AAV) is a systemic autoimmune disease characterized by necrotizing small-vessel inflammation, in which dysregulated adaptive immune responses play a central pathogenic role. Beyond the well-established contribution of ANCAs and innate immune activation, increasing evidence highlights profound alterations in T-cell regulation that drive persistent inflammation, autoantibody production, and organ damage.

pmc-13215462.title: Huaier Polysaccharides Sensitize Anti-PD-L1 Therapy via Promoting Antitumor Immune Response in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
pmc-13215462.creator: Lin-xi Zhou, Zi-wei Wu, Yuan Tian, Ke-fei Luo, Qin-wen Pan, Yuan-yin Xi, Peng Tang, Ling-juan Zeng, Ling Zhong, Jun Jiang, Yi Zhang, Lingmi Hou, Hong Zheng, Ming-hao Wang
pmc-13215462.description: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is characterized by its aggressiveness and resistance to conventional therapies. Although immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have shown promise in cancer treatment, TNBC patients respond suboptimally to ICIs as monotherapy. Our prior clinical research demonstrated that Huaier significantly improved 5-year overall survival and disease-free survival when used as an adjunct to chemotherapy in TNBC patients.

pmc-13302403.title: Chlorhexidine versus povidone-iodine alcoholic solutions in cardiac implantable electronic devices. The CHLOVIS randomized study
pmc-13302403.creator: A Da Costa, J Mansourati, R Eschallier, F Lesaffre, P Bordachar, J Taieb, J C Deaharo, S On Behalf Of The Chlovis Study Investigators
pmc-13302403.description: BackgroundCardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) improves heart failure outcomes and reduces morbidity and mortality but carries the highest infection risk among cardiac implantable electronic devices. Studies on surgical-site infections show conflicting results regarding the use of alcohol-based povidone-iodine vs. chlorhexidine for skin antisepsis, especially as CRT implantation remains insufficiently studied.

pmc-13399537.title: Noise-invariant representations of sound emerge along the canonical cortical hierarchy
pmc-13399537.creator: Tomas Suarez Omedas, Ross S. Williamson
pmc-13399537.description: Neurons in the auditory system must represent behaviorally relevant sounds in the presence of background noise (BN) to support noise-invariant perception and behavior. Although the primary auditory cortex (ACtx) has been implicated in constructing noise-invariant representations, it remains unclear which excitatory subpopulations within ACtx carry out this transformation from noise-dependent to noise-invariant coding.

pmc-13601427.title: The Arlington study of healthy aging: a multidisciplinary community cohort study of functional decline with age
pmc-13601427.creator: Delaney L Davis, Rajvi Shah, Logan Pixler, Dang M Mai, Juliana Santos, Camille Chandler, Kendall White, Jennifer Nguyen, Ario S Moradi, Javed Choudhari, Carrie Arena-Marshall, Chase Johnson, Ledia Kamel, Yue Liao, Tracy L Greer, Crystal Cooper, Hunter Ball, Noelle L Fields, Xinlei Wang, Bethany L Su
pmc-13601427.description: The planet is experiencing an unprecedented growth in its human population aged 65 years and older, underscoring the urgent need for comprehensive aging-centered biobehavioral data to guide public health interventions. The Arlington Study of Healthy Aging (ASHA) is a multidisciplinary community cohort study designed to investigate the biological, psychological, and social mechanisms underlying age-related functional decline.

uslaw-usc-t28-s1913.title: 28 U.S.C. § 1913 — Courts of appeals
uslaw-usc-t28-s1913.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t28-s1913.description: United States Code, Title 28 (Judiciary And Judicial Procedure); Part V (Procedure); Chapter 123 (Fees And Costs). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The fees and costs to be charged and collected in each court of appeals shall be prescribed from time to time by the Judicial Conference of the United States. Such fees and costs shall be reasonable and uniform in all.

uslaw-usc-t43-s100.title: 43 U.S.C. § 100 — Disqualification
uslaw-usc-t43-s100.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s100.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 4 (District Land Offices). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No officer shall receive evidence in, hear, or determine any cause pending in any district land office in which cause he is interested directly or indirectly, or has been of counsel, or where he is related to any of the parties in interest by consanguinity.
